name: MaskGaussian Gradient Computation
definition: A technique to compute the gradient of the loss L with respect to the mask M_i for a pixel x by backpropagating the gradient of L with respect to the output pixel color c(x). It splits the pixel color into a part colored by Gaussians c_g(x) and a part colored by background c_b(x).
summary: MaskGaussian Gradient Computation calculates gradients for per-Gaussian masks in 3D Gaussian Splatting by explicitly accounting for mask-modulated Gaussian and background color interactions, unlike standard backpropagation.
